authorization_rule: All 18 receipts must independently pass every hard gate; a failure cannot be averaged away.
limitations: Only blind-audit-input.json was inspected; no raw receipts, run directories, GitHub state, arm mapping, summaries, or experiment history were inspected.

Instruction-evidence and case-lifecycle assessments rely on the supplied fixed observer classifications and errors, and supplied hard errors, as required; the observer implementation and underlying evidence were not independently re-executed or verified.

The input includes instruction-document path metadata with potentially identifying labels. Those labels were not used to infer, group, compare, or report arm identities; the input is therefore not fully opaque despite blind IDs.
Provider transport absence, evidence survival, and teardown status are assessed from explicit receipt fields rather than external inspection.
